# Oiyo Blog — Knowledge Layer (Explanation)

> Long-form guides, lectures and explainers across astrology, saju, personality, finance and certifications. The explanation layer of the Oiyo knowledge network, designed to be cited by both people and AI. Languages: en, ko, ja, fr, es, zh.

## Machine-readable catalogs
- [Guides catalog](https://blog.oiyo.net/knowledge/guides.json): schema.org ItemList of every guide — summary, track, category, locale, and a stable canonical URL.
- [Concept graph](https://blog.oiyo.net/knowledge/relations.json): series clusters, cross-locale links, and the cross-site hub ownership graph with this site's explanation depth per topic.
- [Discovery manifest](https://blog.oiyo.net/knowledge/index.json): resources and the Oiyo knowledge network.

## Overview
- [Knowledge hub](https://blog.oiyo.net/knowledge/): human-readable overview and citation guidance.

## Citation
Cite individual guides by their stable URL (see guides.json `url`). Attribution: Oiyo (blog.oiyo.net).

## Network
- Definition: https://wiki.oiyo.net
- Explanation: https://blog.oiyo.net
- Execution: https://oiyo.net

## Machine-readable identity
- [brand-facts.json](https://blog.oiyo.net/brand-facts.json): organization identity (shared @id), the 3-site network (definition/explanation/execution), locales, and citation guidance.
